## Bulk update deals

Use bulk update to change many deals at once.

1. Go to **Deals** and open the list view.
2. Select the deals to change:
   - Select the checkbox on each row.
   - Or select **Select all** to pick every deal on the page.

3. Select **Bulk update** and choose the field to change.
4. Enter the new value and select **Apply**. The change runs in the background and can take a few minutes.
5. Check the notification when it finishes.

After the update, the deal history shows who made the change.
